note: Real DamDays forecasts. Runway: Tidemark L3 refitted on all answers known by 2026-09-14. Rewind and Rating: the test season 2018-19, from the frozen model fitted only on answers known before 1 Jul 2016. Scores: development regions, 2016-2026, scored once; the sealed region is opened Sat 3 Oct 17:30.

coverage.text: 894 farm-like dams (DEA Waterbodies outlines of 0.54 to 4.95 ha that look and behave like farm dams) in NSW Central West. 576 of them have a forecast today; the others are already below a third, have not refilled lately, or have no clear look in the last 60 days. Smaller dams, tanks and bores are not visible.

limits: Only dams of at least about 0.54 ha (6 Landsat pixels) are visible; smaller dams, tanks and bores are not.
Water area, not depth: 'below a third' means below a third of the dam's usual full wet area.

Test numbers: the scores were measured once on July 2016 to June 2026, years the model never learned from. The pre-event research had looked at these years, so they are slightly optimistic; the sealed region is the clean test.

It ranks farms better than it times droughts: the rating tells which cells run dry in a season (ranking accuracy 0.81 within a season), but not well which seasons a given cell runs dry (0.58 within a cell's own history).

On average the runway chances were a little high (average forecast 0.22, actual rate 0.21). The DamDays floor held for 90.0% of forecasts (target 90%), but only 87.2% in its worst July-June year (2023).
Live forecasts start from each dam's latest clear satellite look; some looks are weeks old.
